text_block_list.text: I happen to spot Special Week and Seiun Sky walking together one day.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oh, are you headed to karaoke too, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: We're off to get some intense practice in at karaoke!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Since there's no training today, we figured we'd practice for our winning concerts instead!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: We were gonna grab burgers, but then Spe suddenly said food's off the table…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Maybe she's worried about her wei—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Say! You know what's really on my mind?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: How we should practice our singing for everyone out there cheering us on!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Uh-huh, sure. Let's go with that.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Actually… Trainer, why don't you come with us?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I'm pretty sure that supporting us with winning concerts is part of your duties too.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: It'd be great to have you with us! Then you can give us feedback!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yaaay! Thank you so much! Now I'm really fired up!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Good job, Trainer. You gotta make sure you take good care of your racer!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Clear, bri—nanana—for a lovely race… Clear, bright… somethin' somethin'… ♪ Ack.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: The karaoke machine lets you slow down the song's tempo, so how about starting at a slower speed?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oooh, that's a great idea!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: While you're doing that, I'm gonna order some food.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: What?! You're ordering food?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I'm starving! I came out expecting to eat, but here I am at karaoke.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Now what should I get? I think I'll have some pizza, fried chicken, cheeseburgers, carrot sticks…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Drool…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Spe, you don't have to be so harsh on yourself, y'know…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Sure, it's important to maintain a healthy weight, but it's also important to eat tasty things and get the nutrients you need.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: B-but I have to maintain my body weight for racing…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: And I wanna show my fans my gratitude with a great performance after the race too…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: This is where you come in, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Spe's trying to do her best for her fans by going to extreme lengths and skipping meals.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, I'm here wanting to eat tasty burgers and carrots.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: What do you think Spe should do?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Trainer…
choice_data_list: For everyone's sake and for your own, get some energy!
For everyone's sake and for your own, strengthen your resolve!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: You're right… Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I have to nourish myself so I can do my best for everyone!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hand me that menu, Sei! I've gotta get me some nutrients!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Have at it! Order whatever you want! We've got a chaperone to pay for us, after all!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! ♪ Maybe? Who knows.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: In any case, all's well that ends well for Spe. Thanks to you, Trainer.
And so, the three of us enjoy our time at karaoke with some tasty food.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: …Yeah, you're right! Everyone cheers me on because of how hard I work!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Okay! I've gotta strengthen my resolve and get through this with sheer willpower!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I see… I guess I'll forget about eating too, then.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: You're clearly devoted, Spe, so let's crank the intensity of this practice session to the max!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?! Why?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: No time to coast by on easy mode! Put the tempo back to normal!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Y-yes, ma'am!
And so, the three of us enjoy karaoke while they practice for their winning concerts.
